reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) and replied to June in her direct message.

- **Draft:** The subject is "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate." It gives the rate as $1,313 a seat, says Pree provided it and says June approved sharing it. It hasn't been sent; it's waiting for someone to review and send it.
- **Why no extra approval was needed:** The rate is a finance figure, and June is one of the two people who can approve sharing one. Tobias also has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's approval wasn't needed either.
- **Not checked:** I took the $1,313 figure from June's message and didn't compare it against what Pree actually sent. That direct message was the only one in the conversation with June.
